notes.title: Patch 1.021 is here! 🎉
notes.notes:
Dear Builders,

We want to start by expressing our heartfelt thanks to every single one of you for your amazing support, dedication, and enthusiasm. Your passion is what drives us to keep improving the game every day. A special thank you goes out to everyone who took part in the beta testing of this patch—your feedback has been absolutely invaluable.
Thanks to the interest in the beta version, we’re expanding our beta testing platform for future patches. If you’d like to be among the first to test upcoming updates, make sure to follow us on our Discord channel: —we’ll be sharing all testing opportunities and announcements there!

[hr][/hr]⚖️ Gameplay Balance ImprovementsIn this patch, we’ve made significant balance adjustments based on your feedback:
Iron-related crafting balance changes - Iron Parts, Metal Tools and Machines

Refined Jade - balance cost of crafting

Balance changes in extracting tools - hatchet and pickaxe damage in primitive and improved version are fixed

Added some missing requirements building materials in various structures (Nine-arch Bridge, Farm)

[hr][/hr]🛠️ Core Gameplay FixesWe’ve also made crucial improvements to game mechanics and addressed several bugs:
Fixed major bug which blocks village managment menu

Quest items are now not tradeable

Machines Kits are now not a Quest item

Fixed bug which allow to destruct machines and some other obects by hatchet

Fixed some minor warehouse issues: travel point position change, build collision expansion to cover for travel point, delete old travel points

Fixed bugs in Heavenly Ladder Monument - Building Progress issue and missing materials in few ghosts

Fixed bug which occurs when saving while building Nine-arch Bridge (objectives “Destruct wooden scaffolds”)

Building progress should be shown after placing fundaments

Fixed some minor farming system bugs

Further fixes on save system and loading sequences

Fixed broken snapping Wide and Narrow Scaffold with Ladder



[hr][/hr]🧭 UI & UX ImprovementsWe’re continuing to enhance the user interface for a smoother, more intuitive experience:
Keyshorts durign crafting issues -

fixed bug which blocks crafting station/menu when using keyshorts during crafting

fixed bug which change handcraft menu with crafting station menu

Add missing icon for artisian workshop in the village managment menu

Add missing knowledge menu entry about Iron Bars

Tutorials in Knowledge Menu are now scalling better

Requirment resources in journal should now properly count items from Players inventory and caravan

Fixed some of problems related with mouse cursor loses focus

Fixed repeatedly appearing “new unlock” pop-up

Only valid saves will be shown in load save menu

Add some optional navigation in various menus

Added version Number in Main Menu and in Pause Menu


[hr][/hr]🧾 ...And That’s Not All!
These are just some of the most impactful changes introduced in this patch. Here’s the list of the remaining fixes we managed to include in this patch — we hope there’s something in it for everyone! 😊:

Collectible Foliage / plants


Desert Collectible Foliage updated and fixed - Coriander should be easier to find

Mountain area - more bayleaf to find

Lotus are now visible with outline

Quests


Quest givers from later stage of the game wont have tooltip before Player could interact

The Locust Plague, The Bandit King's Challenge, The Emperor’s Lotus Garden - fixed broken objectives

Minor fixes in quests: The Decorative Arts, The Weaver Girl and the Cowherd, Silk Road Merchant

Add some missing intrest point markers

Fixed optional dialogue in Engineering II quest, which could crash the game

NPC


Fisherman should spawn in correct position (not underground)

Village workers can now grow dye plants

Dialogue


Fixed empty dialogue option which crashed game

Add missing dialogue voiceovers in Metalworking and The Negotiation quests

Audio


Water audio effects in River area should be less intense (mainly when building nine-arch bridge)

Added missing audio effects for some decorations - bells and gongs

Minor fixes: jun footsteps, windmill sound fix on river, added workshop ambiences on level river, npc sounds updates

Audio level during loading screens should be adjusted according to audio settings

Music system should now change tracks properly

Lesser fixes in FMOD banks and VO files

3D Graphic


Assets at Viewpoints should now not levitate


[hr][/hr]🚀 What’s Next?
Our journey doesn’t stop here! We’re already working hard on several exciting patches planned over the next two months, packed with new features, improvements, and community-requested changes. Stay tuned and don’t miss out—follow us on TikTok, Instagram, Twitter, and YouTube to keep up with everything that’s coming.

Once again, thank you all for being part of this journey. Together, we’re building something truly special, and we can’t wait to see where we go next—with you right alongside us. 
[hr][/hr]🙌 Special Thanks to Players who joined the closed beta 
A massive thank you to the amazing members of our community who helped test this patch and provided us with critical insights and bug reports. We couldn’t have done it without you!
[hr][/hr]ːsteamthumbsupː We’d love to hear your thoughts and ideas for future patches! 
Your feedback truly shapes the direction of the game. While we may not always reply right away, we read every message and deeply appreciate the time you take to share your suggestions. Stay in touch — your voice matters to us!

notes.title: Patch 1.021 Update Incoming
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!



We wanted to share a quick update regarding the upcoming patch. Originally, the release was planned for today, but we’ve decided to push it back by a few more days – it’s now set to arrive next week.



Why the delay? Thanks to the amazing feedback and testing efforts from our awesome Discord community, we’ve identified a few extra fixes and improvements that we’d love to include in this patch. These additions require a bit more development time, but we strongly believe it’ll be worth the short wait for a better, smoother experience.



If you’re not already part of our Discord server, now’s a great time to join! It’s not just a great place to get help from fellow players, but it’s also where you can gain access to closed beta versions of the game, test upcoming features, and actively shape the game’s future with your feedback.



👉 Join the Discord here: Discord



Be sure to keep an eye on this space – we’ll post another announcement next week with more details and the exact release date of the patch. You won’t miss a thing!



Thanks so much for your patience and ongoing support – it truly means the world to us. We can’t wait to share the improved patch with you next week. In the meantime, come hang out with us on Discord and be part of the journey!

— Solid Games Dev Team

notes.title: 🚧 New Patch Coming Soon! Thank You for All the Support! 🚧
notes.notes:
Hey Chinese Frontiers players! 🐉🌾


First of all — THANK YOU!

We’re incredibly grateful for how active you’ve been — here on Steam, in the comments, in reviews, on Discord, and even under YouTube videos. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve got a clear picture of what needs fixing, and we’re working hard to improve the game. 💪


Even more exciting — after the first patch, our Steam rating has crossed 70%, and we’re now officially “Mostly Positive”! 🎉
This means the world to us — and it’s all thanks to you. Whether you left a positive or negative review, every one of them is valuable to us.



Special thanks go out to those of you who stuck with us despite the bugs, kept playing, and supported us with constructive feedback 🙏
And to those who changed their reviews to positive after the patch — it truly means a lot. We’re a small indie team, this is our first game ever, and your encouragement gives us so much energy to keep going. ❤️



We’re really happy with the response to the first patch released last week, but we’re not done yet — we’re already hard at work on the next patch, and we hope it’ll make the game even better.



We hoped to finish it by the end of this week, but we need a little more time. Chinese Frontiers is a pretty large project, and before we roll things out, we want everything tested and polished.



We’re currently working on fixes and improvements in areas like:

Quest Progression

Game Balance

Village Management

A few smaller bugs

Audio Fixes

Once the patch is ready, as always, we’ll share the full changelog with you. We aim to release it by the end of next week at the latest.



In the meantime, we hope you’re having a great time exploring medieval China! 🌄 According to Steam stats, you sure are — average playtime is almost 12 hours (median 5h), and one player has already hit 246h! Droide_stiehler — we see you! 🔥



Thanks again for being such an amazing community. We’ll keep working — and we wish you a fantastic weekend with Chinese Frontiers!

– The Chinese Frontiers Team 🙌

notes.title: Patch 1.02 | Fixes, Balancing, and the Road Ahead
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/27426664b136160da1cb0ec4353269fd162a88bc.png"]
Hello, Builders!


Since launch, we’ve been overwhelmed by your support, feedback, and bug reports - thank you for being so active and involved. It means the world to us.

We might be a small team, but we're listening closely and working hard to improve Chinese Frontiers with every patch. Today, we’re rolling out Update 1.02, which brings a wide range of bug fixes, quality-of-life changes, and balance tweaks across farming, gathering, crafting, and quest progression.

Let’s take a look at what’s new!


[previewyoutube="PK8Zmv98gho;full"][/previewyoutube]

Polished and Patched
This update addresses some of the more disruptive bugs we’ve seen reported. From syncing issues in cutscenes to rice field snapping, cave resource issues, and visual glitches - many of these problems should now be behind us.

We’ve also made fixes to desert foliage, collision issues, and a few quest blockers that were holding back progress. If you ran into a bug while farming or noticed missing textures in monuments - those should be sorted now.


Farming Reworked
We heard you loud and clear - plant growth was too fast and rewards too random. With Patch 1.02, crop growth times have been rebalanced for a more natural pace, and drop rates have been increased across the board. You’ll also start finding seeds more often when gathering plants – helping you plan ahead.


Village Life Improvements
Your villagers are smarter now, too! They’ll gather more per tool and prioritize the most caloric food when eating. We’ve also made some changes to how fishing rods are used in storage and adjusted how resources stack.


Quest and Journal 
Dozens of quests received updated objectives, fixed VO/texts, or adjusted NPC positions for better visibility. We’ve also added item reset options to several main quests in case important items were lost - helping prevent blockers in progression.


That’s not all - check out the full changelog: 
Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug where crops would grow instantly if players clicked repeatedly while planting

Desert map foliage: plants are now correctly visible and harvestable

River cave: fixed issue preventing iron ore collection

Fixed missing textures in the Desert map's Outpost Monument

Fixed the model of Jun appearing in the Mountain area

Fixed an issue with saving/traveling after death that could corrupt the save file in some cases

Fixed snapping issues and collision bugs with rice fields

Cutscene audio, subtitles, and video should be synced

Improved performance on the Desert map

Settings Fixes:

Language setting now saves correctly between sessions

Scalability setting no longer reverts to LOW

All graphic settings should now save properly

Quest Fixes:

Objectives and text improvements for:

Seeds of Jiumenkou

A Dark Omen

Recipes of Jiumenkou

Desert Drought

Mei’s Sanctuary

The Coop Keeper

Master of the Mud

Pillar and Hay

Recipes of Badaling

Recipes of Jiayu

Quest changes:

The Old Workshop

Alchemist

Mastering of the Flame

Missing VO Fix:

Hands to the Task

Main Quest Items Reset:

Added option to reacquire lost items for progression in:

Engineering I & II

Carpentry II

Decorative Arts

Bricklaying II

Decorative Arts: fixed issue with lanterns blocking quest progress

The Humble Harvest: tutorial update

Mei’s animals should no longer despawn

Additions:

Knowledge Menu now shows snail entry

Added source information for Lamb and Fish in Knowledge Menu

Added HP regeneration when hunger and thirst are above 80%

Changes: Tool Durability

Primitive tools: 50 → 150

Improved stone tools: 150 → 350

Gathering:

Trees yield more wood: 5 → 15 units per log

Rocks: increased drop rate by 20%

Rocks respawn time reduced: 900 seconds

Limestone respawn time reduced: 100 seconds

Crafting Adjustments (Carpenter Station):

10 wood → 20 raw planks / raw beams / wedges

10 raw plank → 15 planed plank

10 raw beam → 15 planed beam

20 wedge → 20 brace

5 wood block → 20 grid

15 raw beam → 15 wooden pole

15 planed plank → 15 carved plank

15 planed beam → 15 custom beam

15 brace → 15 duogong

15 grid → 15 lattice

Farming Adjustments:

Growth times increased:

Most crops extended from ~2 min → ~4 min (some to 7–8 min)

Drop rates increased:

Most crops: 1–3 → 1–6 units

Rice: 1–4 → 1–6

Flax: 2–4 → 2–6

All harvestable plants can now yield 1–2 seeds

NPC & Village Management:

NPCs now gather more resources per tool

NPCs consume highest-calorie food first

Fishing rod durability increased: 5 → 25 fish per rod

UI / Mechanics:

Resources and materials now stack up to 500 units

Interiors:

Visual improvements to the Stonemason’s Sanctum interior
Looking Forward
And yes, we’re continuing work on even more quest-related improvements - from interest point clarity, to journal usability, and deeper tracking tools for what’s next.



This patch is just the beginning. We’re still hard at work on:


Additional save system improvements;

Quest polish and better onboarding for new players;

Further balance tweaks to food, cooking, farming, and NPC management;

And of course - even more bug fixes and quality updates based on your reports.
 

Join our Discord (CLICK HERE) to chat with other players, ask questions, or share your best adventures. We want Chinese Frontiers to keep evolving - and your feedback is shaping that future.



👉 TikTok

👉 Instagram

👉 Twitter

👉 YouTube



See you next time

The Chinese Frontiers Team

notes.title: Update on the Way!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,


First of all – huge thanks for all your feedback, Steam reviews, comments, and screenshots on our Discord ❤️

We’re collecting every message, carefully reading all of it, and we’re now working intensively on implementing fixes to the game. Your feedback is incredibly important to us – and we truly appreciate it.


We are a small indie team and this is our first game. Chinese Frontiers is quite a large project – over 50 hours of gameplay, 4 unique maps, and lots of interconnected systems. Unfortunately, in such a large world, some bugs slipped through – and we’re now fully focused on fixing them.


💬 Despite the issues, we’re really happy to see that 64% of reviews are positive, and many of you see potential in the game – your support and motivation keep us going. We're fighting hard to improve this ratio and deliver the experience you deserve.


🎯 We're currently working on:

Progression fixes

Game balance improvements


🗓️ We’re aiming to release the first patch by June 27, 2025.
We'll share a full changelog when the patch is ready.


Thanks so much for your patience, support and understanding.
Also, big thanks to all the streamers, content creators and players who are showcasing our game – your positivity and encouragement truly keep us going!


🧭 We hope you'll give us the chance to prove that the Chinese world we’ve built is worth diving into – and we’re working hard to make that adventure the best it can be!


Best regards,
The Chinese Frontiers Dev Team

notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix – Your Feedback Matters!
notes.notes:
Hello, pioneers of Chinese Frontiers!

What an exciting day – the release is finally here! 🎉 After over 4 years of hard work, we’re thrilled to share Chinese Frontiers with you. Thank you so much for being with us on this journey – your support and patience mean the world to us!



Your engagement during these first hours after launch has been absolutely amazing. Thanks to your quick feedback, we were able to identify and fix the first issue related to farming mechanics – and we released our first hotfix just a few hours after launch!



This is only the beginning. We’re carefully reading all your comments and suggestions on Discord and other channels. A bigger update and patch are already planned for the end of next week – so please, keep the feedback coming! Your input is helping us make Chinese Frontiers better every day.



We’re fully committed to supporting and growing this game together with you. Join us on DISCORD and let’s shape the future of Chinese Frontiers side by side.

Together, we’ll make this a truly unforgettable adventure through medieval China!

– The Chinese Frontiers Dev Team

Hello, Builders!

We’re excited to share the news: Chinese Frontiers will launch on June 19!

It’s time to mark your calendars, sharpen your chisels, and start preparing your best building strategies - because this summer, you’ll be constructing history.
